title: Quantitative Perceptual Measures of Melanoma ABC Features
thumbnail_alt: Melanoma ABC feature rating experiment screenshot
summary: Continuous, ratio-scale perceptual measures of melanoma asymmetry, border irregularity, and colour variance — derived from 40,000+ pairwise human judgements using the Bradley-Terry-Luce model — complement rather than duplicate computer vision estimates. Combining both sources improves melanoma classifier performance beyond either alone, demonstrating that human perceptual science has a concrete role in medical AI development.
